title: The wasm32-unknown-unknown Rust target is not installed
summary: NEAR contracts compile to wasm32-unknown-unknown. Without the target, wasm builds fail until it is added with rustup.
message: The rustup target wasm32-unknown-unknown is not installed.

evidence.note: cargo-near's own proposal for `cargo near check` lists verifying that this target is installed. We installed it up front and did not observe the failure.
